shots.title: A SUGAR CUBE THAT WEIGHS A BILLION TONS
shots.purpose: Anchor an impossible number to the most ordinary object a viewer can picture
shots.claim: a sugar-cube-sized piece of neutron-star material weighs about 1 billion tons
shots.evidence: macro plate of a single sugar cube + 1,000,000,000 TONS number pop
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in on the cube: stillness first so the number pop lands as the contradiction
shots.transition_reason: hard cut from kitchen scale to stellar scale — the cut is the joke

shots.purpose: Show the star dying before explaining the mechanism
shots.claim: when the fuel ends, a giant star's core collapses in seconds
shots.evidence: dying-star plate + circle highlight on the collapsing core
shots.motion_reason: lateral drift outward: the star is losing itself
shots.transition_reason: cut to diagram as narration switches from scene to mechanism

shots.purpose: Build the collapse mechanism step by step, baseline first
shots.claim: protons and electrons crush into neutrons; collapse takes seconds
shots.evidence: D1_collapse stages s0-s1: giant star, then shrinking core with arrows
shots.motion_reason: static hold; the staged diagram build is the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut inside the same diagram — s2 continues the argument

shots.purpose: Land the reveal: more than the Sun's mass inside a 20 km sphere
shots.claim: 1.4 Suns of mass pressed into a sphere about 20 km wide
shots.evidence: D1_collapse stages s2-s3: 20 km city-scale ring, then mass annotation
shots.motion_reason: static hold; stage s3 is the reveal — no camera move to dilute it
shots.transition_reason: cut to the scale diagram: from what it is to how much it weighs

shots.purpose: Turn an abstract tonnage into visible architecture: 170 pyramids per cube
shots.claim: 1 billion tons is about 170 Great Pyramids of Giza
shots.evidence: D2_pyramid stages s0-s2: the cube, pyramid stack x170, key number
shots.motion_reason: near-static hold; the three-stage build carries the escalation
shots.transition_reason: cut back to macro texture so the number returns to the object

shots.purpose: Rest the scale on the object itself: balanced on your fingertips
shots.claim: 170 pyramids of mass per sugar cube
shots.evidence: macro cube facets + 170 PYRAMIDS number pop
shots.motion_reason: tight punch-in on crystal facets — physical intimacy after abstraction
shots.transition_reason: hard cut to ground level for the drop-it thought experiment

shots.purpose: Make the consequence physical: the ground cannot stop it
shots.claim: dropped on Earth, the fragment punches straight through the crust
shots.evidence: impact plate: clean circular hole through cracked ground + circle highlight
shots.motion_reason: punch-in on the hole — the motion echoes the action
shots.transition_reason: hard cut to 1967 archive-style plate for the history twist

shots.purpose: Deliver the twist: humanity met neutron stars by accident, thinking the signal was aliens
shots.claim: first detection 1967: a signal flashing every 1.3 seconds, nicknamed LGM-1
shots.evidence: radio-telescope plate + EVERY 1.3 SECONDS number pop under chapter chrome
shots.motion_reason: slow drift across the dish line — archive-footage patience
shots.transition_reason: cut to night sky: from human history back to the object

shots.purpose: Land the payoff: the closest one is still impossibly far — relief as the ending
shots.claim: nearest known neutron star is about 400 light-years away; Voyager would need about 7 million years
shots.evidence: night-sky plate + star-marker annotation, then 400 LIGHT-YEARS key-number overlay
shots.motion_reason: pull-back: the frame lets go of the viewer, matching the closing line
shots.transition_reason: final shot; end card closes without a call to action
